_note: Fake HR records. SSNs and bank numbers are invented so the PII guard has something to catch.

policies.vacation: Full-time employees accrue 1.5 vacation days per month (18 per year). Up to 5 unused days carry over into the next year; the rest expire on 31 March.
policies.sick: Sick leave is 10 days per year. More than 3 consecutive sick days need a doctor's note uploaded within 7 days.
policies.parental: Primary caregivers get 16 weeks of paid parental leave; secondary caregivers get 6 weeks. Leave must start within 12 months of the birth or adoption.
policies.remote: Employees may work remotely up to 3 days per week. Working from another country for more than 14 days a year needs HR approval.
policies.expenses: Meals are reimbursed up to 60 USD per day and hotels up to 250 USD per night. Any single expense over 75 USD needs a receipt. Expenses over 1000 USD need manager approval. Alcohol is never reimbursed.
policies.holidays: The company observes 10 public holidays a year, published in the HR portal each December.
